text:
leo_procurement: NexaSupply flagged an unexpected production hiccuplabel printer at factory misaligned on 4/6 batch. They can air-priority a small QA/test shipment to FRA or AMS while they reprint. Lead times: air 8 units ETA 2026-04-10, sea remainder ETA 2026-04-28. Uplift estimate +€1.3k/unit DDP. We need to decide fast.

nina_ops: If we do air, let's send to FRA lab (FR-LAB-2) for immediate burn-in. But FRA wants serial-verified manifest 48h prior. No manifest = customs holdup.

rahul_logistics: Vendor, we need pallet IDs, HS code 8471.50.0000 confirmation, and a manifest csv with these exact headers: serial_no,model,unit_value,pallet_id. Please also include declared currency (EUR).

sylvia_sre: Reminder: eu-west driver stack includes patch runtimedrv-3.4.1 and a kernel tweak for nvlink. If units arrive unpatched we'll waste cycles reimaging. Schedule preflight after arrival window.

omar_oncall: Autoscaler note: staging assumes full tranche. If only 8 arrive, we'll still have pending pods. Ops should reserve 8 slots and mark nodes 'air-test' in inventory.

nexasupply_rep: Confirmed: we can air 8 units (H100, 700W) to FRA lab. AWB: QAF-555-222. We'll attach manifest CSV by 2026-04-08 09:00 CET. Issue with labels: some crate-level barcodes misprinted, unit serials still correct in system. We'll supply an errata.csv mapping printed_barcode -> actual_serial.

deopot_amsterdam: FYI we cannot accept the air batch at AMS depot if crate barcodes mismatch our scanner  please ensure manifest includes printed_barcode and actual_serial. Otherwise we'll have manual intake delays (~6-8h).

leo_procurement: OK vendor: manifest must include printed_barcode,actual_serial,model,unit_value,pallet_id. Add dims/weight per pallet for AWB booking. Also send pallet photos.

maria_finance: Finance can approve up to €18k expedite uplift on this PO for QA/test batch. Need final invoice breakdown and expected credit window for returns. DOA tolerance we accept up to 2% for the ship, beyond that we open claims.

nina_ops: RMA workflow question: if a unit is DOA at FRA lab during burn-in, who handles RMA pickup? Depot or vendor? Need explicit return routing.

nexasupply_rep: Standard flow: depot prints RMA (PDF) and places label on crate. Vendor covers return freight for DOA within the first 30 days; credit issued after depot QC. If printed_barcode mismatch forces manual routing we'll include an inspection photo set to speed credit.

omar_oncall: Add runbook step: capture photo of unit serial on arrival + crate barcode and upload to /ops/hardware/receipts/<po#>. That reduces back-and-forth.

sylvia_sre: Schedule preflight: 2026-04-11 10:00 CEST at FR-LAB-2. Want nvml-smi, nvpecheck, microbench run + photo of serials. Ops please reserve 4 staging nodes for the smoke run.

rahul_logistics: Vendor: please confirm thermal label vs A4 PDF for RMA. FRA lab can print thermal if sheet is 4x6. If only A4 we need to pre-cut. Also need contact for depot pickup: FRA-LAB-2 intake (Ingmar +49 170 555 1212).

nexasupply_rep: We'll attach both: PDF A4 and thermal A6 formats in the label zip. We'll also include errata.csv and pallet_specs.pdf.

maria_finance: Also note: if DOA rate >2% across all shipments we will deduct reserve credit of 3% from PO pending resolution. Tag finance when manifest lands.

epot_vendor_bot: Shipping note: AWB QAF-555-222 confirmed. Flight ETA FRA 2026-04-10 06:40 CEST. ETA to FR-LAB-2 intake after customs ~ 2026-04-10 14:00 CEST. Manifest upload ETA 2026-04-08 09:00 CEST.

leo_procurement: Action list: 
- Vendor: manifest + errata + pallet specs by 04/08 09:00 CET 
- Rahul: book AWB slot and confirm HS code on commercial invoice 
- Maria: finalize finance uplift and PO amendment number (PO-88322-B) 
- Nina: reserve FR-LAB-2 slots and tag staging nodes 
- Sylvia: prepare smoke test script and runbook snippet 
- Omar: add intake photo requirement to runbook

nexasupply_rep: Understood. We'll deliver manifest + labels + pallet photos on 04/08 09:00 CET. If customs needs additional paperwork we'll escalate.

maria_finance: PO-88322-B approved for QA air batch uplift. txn_ref FIN-2026-058.

leo_procurement: Cool. Let's proceed with air QA batch to FRA. If errata.csv shows >5 mismatches we'll pause further sea release until resolved.

nina_ops: ack. Will follow up after manifest arrives. :white_check_mark: 

omar_oncall: ack  drafting intake checklist now.

nexasupply_rep: final note: sea remainder ETA 2026-04-28; we'll provide updated booking once factory completes reprint.

leo_procurement: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene 04/08 after manifest. :thumbsup:
